0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Learningway is worried one of his fellow Loporrits has met with misfortune.

24.original: Investigate the water reserve in Greatest Endsvale.

25.original: Fill the empty bottle with allegedly purifying water.

26.original: Pour the allegedly purifying water on the shaky Loporrit.

48.original: If you're not too busy, might I trouble you to look into something for me?

49.original: I recently heard word that one of our fellows is acting strangely near one of the water reserves in Greatest Endsvale.

50.original: Everyone knows that water is for our passengers-to-be, and if anything should happen to those reserves, it could ruin everything!

51.original: I doubt they would talk to me, but I suspect they might be willing to confess their plans if you asked them. You'll help, won't you?

52.original: The reserve you're looking for is on the northern end of Greatest Endsvale. Please hurry before they do anything foolish.

53.original: I can't imagine what they would want with that water, but we can't risk anything happening to that reserve.

60.original: Wah! Who are you? What's the matter?

61.original: Suspicious? Me? But why? I haven't done anything wrong.

62.original: Urianger was teaching me about telling fortunes, and I've been trying to practice so I could show the others how it's done.

63.original: In fact, I even made my own carrot cards, though they're not quite as fancy as Urianger's. I tried using them to see what good fortune will come to the people of Etheirys when they visit the moon, but...

64.original: Maybe I did it wrong, but the cards had nothing good to say. I got the complete opposite. So I thought I'd try again after purifying myself in the water here.

65.original: That is what your people do, yes? I read that it's possible to purify oneself using water, but I don't feel as if anything has changed. Maybe I've missed a step somewhere...

66.original: Oh! Could you draw the water for me? Coming from Hydaelyn's chosen, I'm sure it'd be the most purifyingest water ever!

67.original: All you have to do is fill this empty bottle with water and pour it on me. Please─the outcome of my carrot card reading is in your hands!

68.original: I know good fortune is in the cards for the people of Etheirys. I just need a little help proving it.

69.original: Ah, how refreshing. I feel like a brand-new Loporrit!

70.original: Already I can feel my spirit overflowing with good fortune. Time to have another look at those carrot cards, and see what awaits the people of Etheirys.

71.original: Well? Did you find out what that good-for-nothing was up to?

72.original: Oh! Really? Well, that's...actually quite admirable, making such efforts to understand the culture of Etheirys.

73.original: That said, I'm not sure one is meant to redraw cards until they find a desired result. Or perhaps I misheard how fortune telling is meant to work...

74.original: ...Maybe I should go and talk to them about that.

75.original: Then again, there's been no harm done, and they mean well. Perhaps I'll discuss the finer points of card reading with them another day. Thank you for looking into this!
